program_name: Systems Engineering, Policy Analysis and Management
faculty_or_school: Faculty of Technology, Policy and Management
verification_status: Verified - genuinely missing from the existing 15-record Bachelor's list already in the live database. Confirmed present on TU Delft's official English-language Bachelor's index (17 total listed, incl. this one and 'Health and Technology' below), independently retrieved twice via WebFetch and browser get_page_text on 2026-08-21, both returning an identical 17-item list. This programme's own dedicated English page was also fetched directly and explicitly confirms Dutch-medium instruction.
researcher_notes: TU Delft's own bachelor's index states: 'Please note that only four programmes are offered fully in English; Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Earth, Climate and Technology and Nanobiology' - SEPAM is not among those four. Its own dedicated English page additionally states explicitly: 'The Systems Engineering, Policy analysis and Management programme is taught in Dutch. Therefore, the information about this programme is only available in Dutch.' This is an EXPLICIT per-programme confirmation, not an assumption from the page displaying in English. Dutch programme name (used in the URL slug and on the Dutch site) is 'Technische Bestuurskunde'; the official English rendering used here is TU Delft's own, taken verbatim from its English bachelor's index and programme-page title. Faculty confirmed as Technology, Policy and Management (TBM/TPM) via WebSearch cross-reference (Studiekeuze123.nl, TU Delft OCW) since the English programme page itself does not state a faculty name. Duration of 3 years is TU Delft's blanket statement for ALL its bachelor's programmes ('All these bachelor's programmes last three years'), not a SEPAM-specific restatement, since the English page defers entirely to the Dutch site. A cross-check PDF brochure snippet ('16 BSc programmes') is consistent with 15 pre-existing + this one = 16 current, live Bachelor's programmes (the 17th, Health and Technology, is not yet live - see next record).

verification_status: Provisional / NOT YET a live programme - listed on TU Delft's official Bachelor's index with an explicit '(accreditation pending)' annotation next to 'Location: Erasmus MC'. DURATION DELIBERATELY LEFT NULL: TU Delft's bachelor's index states all its listed bachelor's programmes last three years, but that statement was written for its currently-running programmes; since this one is accreditation-pending and not yet operating, that figure is not treated as a confirmed statement of THIS programme's specific duration. OFFICIAL_PROGRAM_URL LEFT NULL: unlike every other TU Delft programme found, this one has no dedicated tudelft.nl programme page yet (only a card/note on the index page itself); none could be located via WebFetch or browser navigation during this research pass. campus value 'Erasmus MC' is verbatim from the index page's own 'Location:' label (Erasmus MC is located in Rotterdam).
